source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: You run a trained recurrent block four times instead of twice, using the same weights and input. What resource change is most directly supported?

options.text: Twice as many independent weights have been learned.
options.feedback: Applying weights more times does not create additional independent parameters. Learning new weights would require a different operation.

options.text: More block computations occur without adding independent weights.
options.feedback: The shared block is applied twice more. That increases processing work even though the trained parameter set is unchanged.

options.text: The maximum number of input tokens has doubled.
options.feedback: Recurrent depth and context capacity are separate resources. More passes do not establish a larger context window.

options.text: The number of displayed reasoning tokens must double.
options.feedback: Hidden processing operates on vectors. More recurrent passes do not require a proportional increase in displayed text.
